items.title: Billy McBride and Mary McBride ("Mack and Mack") Interview, 1959-07-01
items.q: Yank? Yeah, I know all those fellas, knew them then.

ctx.x: That's who I was trying to say, who played trombone? Buddy Johnson, Little Shortfella. Do you remember them, Matt? Yeah, I remember Buddy Johnson.
Yank? Yeah, I know all those fellas, knew them then.
Yank was a drummer. Yeah. Yank played drums.
